profile.summaryJa: ヨシャファトの母アズバはシルヒの娘と記されています。シルヒ本人について本文はこの系譜以外の情報を示しません.

wikipedia.title: Azubah (mother of Jehoshaphat)
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版のアズバ記事は、アズバをシルヒの娘と記しています。記事の主題はシルヒ本人ではありません。
wikipedia.verifiedHeadingOrText: The Azubah article states that Azubah was daughter of Shilhi and cites 1 Kings 22:42; it is a single-source stub about Azubah, not Shilhi.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
